description: This Java class defines the response object for the 'ModifyThingDefinition' command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles creation, parsing, and serialization of responses indicating modifications or creations of thing definitions, including associated metadata.

classes.name: ModifyThingDefinitionResponse
classes.description: An immutable class representing the response to a modify or create 'Thing' definition command, capable of serializing/deserializing JSON representation, and providing access to the resulting state.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a ModifyThingDefinitionResponse indicating a newly created definition with HTTP status 201 (Created).

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a ModifyThingDefinitionResponse indicating a modified definition with HTTP status 204 (No Content).

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string or object into a ModifyThingDefinitionResponse, extracting the thing ID, definition, and status.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the modified or created Thing.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the new or modified ThingDefinition if present.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the definition if available.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for the definition resource.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new response object with the specified Ditto HTTP headers.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Indicates that this response class supports only JSON Schema version 2.
